why_it_matters: If the 0.76 is not in Kim 2016, the PFHxS row of equation (5) rests on a misattribution, and PFHxS is one of three compounds there. The project already flags a separate 'MAJOR INTERNAL CONTRADICTION' in EPA Appendix B over a 'Kim et al. (2016b)' whose half-lives differ 13-157 fold between EPA's own narrative and tables, with a suspected chemical misattribution. Two independent provenance problems around the same author-year is reason to check rather than assume.
resolution: RESOLVED IN FAVOUR OF THE VALUE. The PDF was read in Stage 20. Kim 2016 collected urine and feces, defines CL_R = Xu(t)/AUC in its Methods, and reports CL_R in Table 4 for all three compounds in both sexes after IV dosing. The 0.76 is PFHxS, male, IV. Four independent checks of CL_R/CL against urinary percentages stated separately in Kim's Results text agree to within 0.2 percentage points. Equation (5)'s PFHxS row stands.
